answer.reason: Only EZR 5:8 names the province of Judea and says something happened there, the building of the house of God, so one clause fits.

clauses.english: was where the house of God was being built, and the work prospered
clauses.quote: this work goeth fast on, and prospereth in their hands

doubts: EZR 7:14 and EZR 9:9 name Judah, the land and kingdom, and DAN 2:25, DAN 5:13 and DAN 6:13 speak of the captives of Judah, so I left them out as likely belonging to another record.
